title: Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense. Hellboy is a superpowered paranormal investigator created by writer/artist Mike Mignola and appearing in comic books published by Dark Horse Comics. The character first appeared in San Diego Comic-Con Comics #2 (August 1993), and has since appeared in various miniseries, one-shots, and intercompany crossovers.

The story Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. Hellboy joins, but is betrayed by the Club and left to die. He survives, and, despite being given a means to escape, decides to engage the Giants in battle.
